Remark
[Remark 3.5] 1. ch9:3.5In fact it is not necessary that $K$ be bounded away from zero but only that $K$ not approach zero too fast. In this respect, see E. Calabi, "On Ricci curvatures and geodesics", Duke Math. J. 34 (1967), 667–676 and R. Schneider, "Konvexe Flächen mit langsam abnehmender Krümmung", Archiv der Math. 23 (1972), 650–654.
